items.title: Recognizer armor hit
items.notes: Original 0.48-second stereo pressure thump, saturated electrical crack and falling electronic tail; no sustained metallic ring. Tank impacts use a shorter 0.36-second variation. Three variants with spatial playback and subtle pitch variation; fatal hits use the explosion instead. Audition WAV is generated by scripts/generate-hit-sfx.mjs from the same synthesis used in game.
items.author: Project synthesis

items.title: Tank destruction — layered electronic blast
items.status: Active for CLU and enemy tanks
items.notes: Original 1.65-second low shock, electrical rupture, noise blast and scattered inharmonic debris. Three procedural variants and slight playback-rate variation; stereo world placement and distance attenuation. Audition below uses the same synthesis as gameplay.
items.author: Project synthesis

items.title: Carrier — steady machinery drone
items.notes: Synthesized 16-second stereo loop: stable bass harmonics and quiet diffuse machinery texture. Whole-cycle frequencies avoid a crossfade dip; no amplitude modulation. Generated with scripts/generate-carrier-drone.mjs.
items.author: Project synthesis
